name: Reality Breach
storyline:
You quit your job, moved back to your home country, and isolated yourself for one dream: becoming a game developer. But dreams demand sacrifice, Theo… more than you ever imagined. Your own creation has turned against you, and now it wants to end it all.

Reality Breach is an immersive, first-person psychological horror game set inside the claustrophobic walls of an indie developer's home studio. To survive the night, you must confront an entity born from your own corrupted project, where the line between your game engine and your physical room completely shatters.
summary: Reality Breach is a first-person psychological horror game where your own creation turns against you. Step into the shoes of an exhausted indie developer trapped in a shifting home studio, evading a relentless entity born from your own corrupted code
